answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 7865 Country: India Title: I have few questions to ask 1) Is it ok to eat meat , beef or chicken from non - muslim hotels & restaurants ? 2) Is it ok if non - muslims offer namaz with us ( They have faith in islam but unable tocome forward due to some reasons. Question: Assalamualaikum . khariat? I have few questions to ask 1) Is it ok to eat meat , beef or chicken from non - muslim hotels & restaurants ? 2) Is it ok if non - muslims offer namaz with us ( They have faith in islam but unable tocome forward due to some reasons. Answer ID: 7865 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1074/1074=M/1429) (1) Avoid consuming meat at the restaurants of non-Muslims. Yes, if you are sure that the meat presented there is slaughtered as per the Islamic way, then there is no wrong in eating there. (2) If a person offers salah with jamat , it is acceptable and it will be considered a sign of his being Muslim : وفی الشامی: الکافر اذا صلی بجماعۃ یحکم باسلامہ عندنا۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
